name: motionvault-agent-kit

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search original template, style, background, gradient or UI libraries using words and bounded filters.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get one original template and precise media capabilities.

tools.name: compare_templates
tools.description: Compare 2–5 templates by engine, source media, style and formats.

tools.name: get_build_prompt
tools.description: Return an original template build prompt with bounded user customization.

tools.name: get_source_links
tools.description: Get public source, playground, demo and license links without fetching account data.

tools.name: get_template_source
tools.description: Fetch complete public standalone HTML and asset manifest from the one configured MotionVault origin; 8s/1MB limit.

tools.name: get_asset_manifest
tools.description: List original public poster/video/font asset URLs and ZIP paths; no remote media download.

tools.name: create_cinematic_brief
tools.description: Compose a concrete photographic/CG asset brief and implementation acceptance criteria.

tools.name: plan_storyboard
tools.description: Create mechanism-specific four-chapter shots with precise time/frame/progress ranges.

tools.name: build_motion_timeline
tools.description: Allocate weighted beats to exact seconds, frame ranges and normalized progress.

tools.name: get_design_tokens
tools.description: Generate viewport-specific readable typography, composition tokens and CSS variables.

tools.name: get_easing_curve
tools.description: Calculate a sampled cubic-bezier curve using time-axis inversion, plus CSS easing.

tools.name: analyze_contrast
tools.description: Calculate WCAG contrast for two opaque hex colors and normal/large text thresholds.

tools.name: plan_responsive_crop
tools.description: Compute object-fit cover scale, crop offsets and object-position for a desired subject position.

tools.name: get_export_checklist
tools.description: Return format-specific packaging and playback checks grounded in a selected template.

tools.name: generate_scroll_scaffold
tools.description: Generate complete original pinned native-scroll HTML with reversible chapter states, pause and reduced motion.

tools.name: generate_glsl_shader
tools.description: Generate a working original WebGL fragment/vertex shader and standalone pointer-reactive HTML.

tools.name: validate_motion_spec
tools.description: Check declared typography, source-media claims, export assets and timing for concrete implementation mistakes.

tools.name: get_design_system
tools.description: Get an original style system, declared tokens and DESIGN.md without copying a reference library.

tools.name: get_asset_source
tools.description: Return bundled original asset source, or explicit CSS variables generated from declared style tokens.

tools.name: generate_palette
tools.description: Generate a tonal HSL palette from one seed and calculate actual opaque contrast pairs.

tools.name: generate_type_scale
tools.description: Calculate a modular type scale and fluid CSS across explicit viewport endpoints.

tools.name: generate_spacing_scale
tools.description: Build a consistent spacing rhythm and responsive CSS without mixing unitless lengths.

tools.name: compare_design_assets
tools.description: Compare 2–5 bundled style/UI/background assets, including actual token differences.

tools.name: inspect_html
tools.description: Inspect supplied HTML source for structural counts, resource references, duplicate IDs and broken anchors; never execute it.

tools.name: check_accessibility_markup
tools.description: Find concrete semantic source signals: language, title, headings, image alternatives, labels and empty controls.

tools.name: check_motion_accessibility
tools.description: Review declared motion plus supplied HTML for reduced-motion, pause and scroll-safety signals.

tools.name: analyze_performance_budget
tools.description: Sum supplied resource bytes by kind and compare explicit initial-load and total budgets.

tools.name: validate_asset_manifest
tools.description: Check ZIP-relative paths, duplicate names, supplied packaged files, resource origins and license gaps.

tools.name: audit_dependencies
tools.description: Review supplied dependency versions and recorded license evidence for source redistribution.

tools.name: review_licensing
tools.description: Triage per-asset evidence for end-project versus library redistribution; preserve restrictive source boundaries.

tools.name: check_media_provenance
tools.description: Compare supplied SHA-256 evidence and provenance requirements without claiming credential-chain verification.

tools.name: plan_launch_preflight
tools.description: Build a release gate table from explicit observed evidence; unknown checks never become passes.

tools.name: verify_template_source
tools.description: Fetch the configured public source endpoint and return its digest, resource findings and catalog media consistency.

tools.name: plan_visual_qa
tools.description: Create exact five-progress capture cases across responsive viewports with media-specific expectations.

tools.name: build_reduced_motion_plan
tools.description: Map declared effects to meaningful still/low-motion alternatives and implementation hooks.

tools.name: generate_responsive_layout
tools.description: Generate original container-responsive CSS for an editorial hero and useful content grid.

tools.name: generate_design_document
tools.description: Create an original DESIGN.md from structured colors, typography, spacing and explicit component rules.

tools.name: list_agent_workflows
tools.description: Discover six reusable specialist role guides and their real tool dependencies; does not spawn agents.

tools.name: get_agent_workflow
tools.description: Get a concrete specialist workflow, deliverables and relevant tools without starting background execution.

resources.name: template-catalog
resources.description: Bundled public original template metadata and build prompts.

resources.name: cinematic-guidelines
resources.description: Framing, typography, media truth, source rights and visual verification rules.

resources.name: server-capabilities
resources.description: Actual tools, skills, workflow guides, limits and supported scope.

prompts.name: build_cinematic_template
prompts.description: Begin an original cinematic template with media-first framing and complete source delivery.

prompts.name: review_motion_template
prompts.description: Review a declared template against cinematic composition and delivery requirements.

prompts.name: plan_product_film
prompts.description: Plan an authored person-to-product-to-macro-to-action cinematic sequence.

skills.name: cinematic-builder
skills.description: Build cinematic websites from original MotionVault templates with authored scroll sequences, photographic or CGI media, functional sections, and complete source delivery. Use for cinematic website creation or visual template adaptation.

skills.name: delivery-review
skills.description: Review cinematic website source packages, asset manifests, dependencies, semantic HTML and actual exported playback. Use for source-delivery defects, broken standalone exports or a requested implementation review.

skills.name: design-systems
skills.description: Discover and apply original MotionVault style systems, UI components, backgrounds, and gradients using downloadable DESIGN.md and editable source. Use for consistent visual systems or a supporting design-library asset.

skills.name: launch-preflight
skills.description: Consolidate observed visual, source, accessibility, rights and product-flow evidence into a concrete release gate table. Use when a cinematic project is being prepared for review, public launch or paid-library release.

skills.name: motion-director
skills.description: Author or diagnose scroll choreography, easing, camera crops, responsive motion, and real GLSL effects for a cinematic website. Use when a site feels static, transitions fail, or a motion system needs implementation.

skills.name: source-provenance
skills.description: Organize asset origin, redistribution evidence, license notices and native-media provenance for a template or commercial library. Use for asset ingestion, source packaging and requested rights/provenance review.

agents.title: Cinematic art director
agents.description: Turn a product or world into distinct authored film states and an original media brief.

agents.title: Motion engineer
agents.description: Implement reversible scroll and bounded GPU motion with accessible alternatives.

agents.title: Design system architect
agents.description: Build coherent palette, type, spacing and component rules from original tokens.

agents.title: Source delivery reviewer
agents.description: Review standalone HTML, manifests, dependency versions and packaged source.

agents.title: Asset rights steward
agents.description: Organize redistribution evidence and native-media provenance without legal guarantees.

agents.title: Launch reviewer
agents.description: Consolidate actual source, visual, accessibility and rights evidence into release gates.

sourceBoundary: Original or explicitly licensed work only. React Bits MIT + Commons Clause components/bundles/ports are interaction research, not commercial template-library source.
